stories.h: Quantum ingenuity can sidestep limits of conventional chips—while using commercially accessible components
stories.t: For decades, computers have steadily grown faster and more powerful. Avik Dutt, an assistant professor of mechanical engineering at the University of Maryland, envisions another dramatic leap forward—one propelled by the quantum properties of light.

stories.h: New nose drops restore youthful memory and fight Alzheimer’s in aging mice
stories.t: A revolutionary new nasal treatment has restored youthful learning and memory performance in aging mice while preventing severe cognitive decline in mice with Alzheimer’s-like disease.

stories.h: Justice is elusive for the Rohingya even after the ICJ’s landmark genocide ruling against Myanmar
